title: Hard checks (with web)
description: Runs the hard checks of the library that apply to a claim ({type, text, data}), cheapest first, and combines them: a failed check decides (contradicted), passes are evidence (supported only if every applicable check passed), anything else leaves the claim open for the verification styles. Includes the checks that read the web. Script checks run in the sandbox when one is available; the claim can say `tainted` or `stakes` to get the strong wall.

origin.note: version 1 could not run code; this one can (check.script)
